## New and notable

### AI

#### [Announcing: GitHub Copilot and Claude Code connectors in Microsoft Agent Framework](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563701)

AI - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework now ships generally available connectors for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, so developers can build .NET and Python agents that delegate coding tasks to either system without writing custom adapter code.

#### [Announcing: Multi-agent orchestration patterns including Magentic in Microsoft Agent Framework](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563571)

AI - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework reaches general availability for multi-agent orchestration patterns, including the dynamic Magentic pattern that delivered 38 percent on GAIA and competitive results on AssistantBench and WebArena in published benchmarks.

#### [Announcing: Agent Harness in Microsoft Agent Framework](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563546)

AI - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework reaches general availability for Agent Harness, the production runtime for agents built with the framework.

#### [Document PII NextGen Playground in Azure AI Language](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=564382)

AI - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

Azure AI Language now offers a refreshed Document PII playground in general availability, giving customers a faster way to evaluate personally identifiable information detection on documents.

#### [Toolboxes in Microsoft Foundry](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563481)

AI - `ga` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Foundry brings Toolboxes to GA, providing a unified endpoint to invoke the most-used tools in prompt agents and callable outside of prompt agents.

#### [Announcing: Tracing for Microsoft Agent Framework (Python and .NET)](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=564071)

AI - `public-preview` / `new` - Medium impact

In public preview, Microsoft Foundry now offers tracing for the Microsoft Agent Framework in both Python and .NET, helping developers observe how agents reason, call tools, and interact with models during execution.

#### [Announcing: CodeAct pattern and Hyperlight containers in Microsoft Agent Framework](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563566)

AI - `public-preview` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework adds the CodeAct pattern in public preview, which lets agents collapse a multi-step plan into a single executable code block rather than chaining one tool call at a time.

#### [Announcing: Episodic procedural memory in Microsoft Agent Framework](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563561)

AI - `public-preview` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework adds episodic procedural memory in public preview, a built-in store that lets agents remember successful task patterns and replay them on similar future requests.

#### [Announcing: Agent Channel for Microsoft Agent Framework multi-agent communication](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563556)

AI - `public-preview` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework introduces Agent Channel in public preview, a built-in primitive that lets agents send structured messages to each other without bespoke routing code.

#### [Announcing: DevUI Agent Inspector for Microsoft Agent Framework](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563551)

AI - `public-preview` / `new` - Medium impact

Microsoft Agent Framework adds DevUI Agent Inspector in public preview, a local debugging surface that shows agent runs as a navigable tree of model calls, tool invocations, and intermediate state.

#### [Document PII playground sample in Microsoft Foundry NextGen](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates?id=563331)

AI - `public-preview` / `updated` - Medium impact

Document-based PII detection in Azure AI Language now ships an initial playground experience in the Microsoft Foundry NextGen portal.
